description: Deal 10% more damage to enemies below 40% Health. Reset your basic Abilities on takedown.

name: Feel the Burn
description: Gain the Feel the Burn Summoner Spell. Feel the Burn casts Ignite and Exhaust on all nearby enemy champions.

name: Frost Wraith
description: Autocast Root nearby enemies for 1.25 seconds every 6.5 seconds.

name: Guilty Pleasure
description: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion restores health.

name: Holy Fire
description: Healing or shielding applies an infinitely stacking Burn to a nearby enemy, dealing max health magic damage over a few seconds.

name: Keystone Conjurer
description: Gain the Summon Aery and Arcane Comet Keystone Runes.

name: Lightning Strikes
description: Gain 20% total Attack Speed. At 3.5 Attacks per second, deal additional magic damage.

name: Bounce of the Poro King
description: Gain Bounce of the Poro King: become the Poro King, bouncing repeatedly to deal physical damage and knock back nearby enemies.

name: Poro Blaster
description: You gather Poros over time. Damaging an enemy fires them all for max health true damage each. At 5 Poros they also knock back.

name: Cheating
description: Press Recall to return to base, buy items, and acquire augments.

name: Repulsor
description: On dropping below 60% or 30% Health, nearby enemies are Knocked Back.

name: Restless Restoration
description: You constantly heal while moving.

name: Self Destruct
description: Periodically a bomb attaches to you. After 13 seconds it explodes, dealing true damage and knocking up enemies.

name: Slow And Steady
description: Your attack speed is locked to 0.65 and all bonus attack speed is converted into attack damage.

name: Slow Cooker
description: Every second, apply an infinitely stacking Burn to nearby enemy champions, scaling with your max Health.

name: Speed Demon
description: Damaging an enemy champion with an ability grants movement speed that decays over time.

name: The Brutalizer
description: Gain 20 Attack Damage, 10 Ability Haste, and 10 Lethality.

name: Tormentor
description: Immobilizing or grounding a champion applies a Burn for 0.6% max health magic damage per second over 5s. Stacks infinitely.

name: Trueshot Prodigy
description: When you damage a champion from far away, fire a Trueshot Barrage at them.

name: Twice Thrice
description: Every 3 attacks, your effects trigger a second time.

name: Upgrade Cutlass
description: Reduces Spectral Cutlass and Lifeline's cooldown, and their active grants damage amplification. Gain 250 gold.

name: Upgrade Hubris
description: On takedown, Hubris heals you and grants movement speed, both scaling with your Eminence stacks. Gain 250 gold.

name: Void Rift
description: Abilities that damage enemies create a Void scar. Two nearby scars merge into a rift between them that damages and slows enemies.

name: Heads Up Cupcake!
description: Cupcakes fly across the bridge. Catching one grants gold and heals the champion hit and nearby allies. Gold scales with healing.

name: Weighted Popoffs
description: Striking enemies with Abilities grants you stacks of Popoff, reducing your non-Ultimate Ability Cooldowns.

name: I'm a Baby Kitty Where is Mama
description: Standing by an ally marks them as Mama. Gain move speed moving toward Mama, plus move speed and heal and shield power near them.

name: Ragebait
description: Gain dodge chance.

name: Do or Die
description: Double the max stacks of Mejai's Soulstealer, Leviathan, and Sword of the Occult.

name: Don't Stop Cleavin'
description: Buy unlimited Black Cleavers; each purchase raises its stats for every copy you own. Immediately gain The Brutalizer.

name: Doran's Biggest Fan
description: Each Doran's item bought past the first stacks onto the original for part of its stats. Passives don't stack and it can't be sold.

name: Drink Up
description: Everyone on your team instantly gains health potions, and you gain more every few takedowns.

name: Time Warp: Heartsteel
description: After gaining Bonus Health, reach into the future and gain a Heartsteel. Heartsteel is not sellable.

name: Gash
description: Gain attack speed and deal bonus true damage on-hit, scaling with your armor.

name: Grandma's Chili Oil
description: Attacks and abilities burn enemies and leave Chili Oil that heals you and burns them. It grows stronger with the burns you apply.

name: Haste Makes Waste
description: Gain cooldown reduction and raise your cooldown reduction cap.

name: Hat on a Hat
description: Headwear items and hats give an extra Ability Power and Magic Resist.

name: The Hex Core
description: Get a Prototype Hex Core. Spend gold to upgrade the Hex Core and permanently upgrade your abilities.

name: Laser Heal
description: Cast a laser for 2.5 seconds that heals allies, and Slows and deals magic damage to enemies.

name: ReEnergize
description: Gain an energized attack dealing damage based on the target's current health. Charges refund fully when you hit a new target.

name: Red Envelopes
description: Red envelopes appear around you randomly. Picking them up gives you Gold and a small amount of a random Stats.

name: Snowball Roulette
description: Mark gains ability haste. Hitting an enemy calls a snowfall that damages and slows nearby enemies. Grants Mark if unequipped.

name: Spirit of the Jungle Main
description: The primary stats of jungle items you own are increased. Only one copy of each item benefits.

name: Stabby Stabby
description: Gain cooldown reduction and raise your cooldown reduction cap.

name: Summoner's Safari
description: While in the jungle or river, you quickly discover consumables. 'Mid? Where we're going we don

name: True Eternity
description: You may buy unlimited Rod of Ages; their stacks build faster and are uncapped. Gain a Catalyst of Aeons.

name: Upgrade: Deathfire Grasp
description: Deathfire Grasp's damage amplification rises and its cooldown falls, and it now hits every champion around the target.

name: Upgrade: Innervating Locket
description: Innervating Locket restores more health and mana, and now affects all allied champions around the target.

name: Upgrade Mikael's Blessing
description: Gain Mikael's Blessing with a reduced cooldown. Its active cleanses nearby allies, heals them, and grants tenacity.

name: Upgrade Death's Dance
description: Upgrades Death's Dance: 40% of damage taken is dealt over 3s, and takedowns instantly heal for 125% bonus AD. Gain 250 gold.

name: Upgrade Ravenous Hydra
description: Hitting an enemy champion with an ability triggers Cleave. Ravenous Hydra gains 18% life steal. Gain 500 gold.

name: Upgrade Sundered Sky
description: Sundered Sky's per-target cooldown drops to 5 seconds and it heals you for 9% of your missing health. Gain 500 gold.

name: Upgrade Thornmail
description: After a few seconds out of combat, your Thornmail or Bramble Vest grows a shell that reflects increased damage from attacks.

name: Upgrade: Zz'Rot Portal
description: Zz'Rot Portal spawns extra minions, plus one more per level. Minions also spawn when the portal is destroyed.

name: Wind Beneath Blade
description: The higher your Armor Penetration and Magic Penetration are, the faster you are.

name: Reload
description: While the ability is active, your basic attack cooldown is reduced.
